about: The reviewed Amazon Bedrock model row of the preview spending gate. The gate (packages/providers/ops/preview_budget_helper.py, BedrockProfile) and the app (packages/providers/src/preview-models.ts) must both equal this file; a price change is a reviewed change to both sides and to this file. The row's id is the United States inference profile's, so every request stays inside the United States. settlement_steps are Amazon's list prices for that profile in USD per million tokens (the model card in the Bedrock user guide, read 2026-11-20): what a reply is charged, at the step its prompt_tokens fall in, plain input, cache writes and cache reads each at their own price. Amazon's prompt cache is on by default and may write any part of a prompt without the request asking, so a call RESERVES every input token at a hold price that no input token can cost more than: the row's input price is the lower step's cache-write price rounded up to a whole nano-USD per token, and reservation.upper_* are the upper step's cache-write and output prices. A request whose utf-8 bytes + overhead_bytes are at most step_tokens reserves at the row's prices (its prompt cannot reach the upper step); above that, at the upper ones, which are also the ceiling the gate's activate check and /remaining use for every slot. efforts is the reviewed thinking-level menu: a request carries reasoning_effort exactly one of these words (the menu holds no "default"), and its first entry is the level the app sends by default. The answer limit travels as max_completion_tokens. A menu change is a reviewed row change on both sides and in this file.

reservation.formula: ((request utf-8 bytes + overhead_bytes) * input price + output_bound * output price) / 1000000
reservation.step_rule: request bytes + overhead_bytes <= step_tokens: the row's prices; above: the upper step's hold prices (the ceiling)

final_writer.about: A final writer may send up to request_bytes with max_completion_tokens up to output_bound (the model's documented maximum output). A full-size request is above step_tokens, so it reserves at the upper step's hold prices (worst_case_reservation_usd), under per_call_cap_usd.
